Senses.Explanation: This line says only to avoid choosing and rejecting; Chan records quote it as the opening condition of the Trust in Mind verse and then test what such avoidance can mean in speech. Teachers quote the formula, ask whether repeating it is itself selection, and place it beside concrete approvals and rejections rather than leaving it as an isolated maxim.
